# Jose Coelho

> The personal site of Jose Coelho: articles about software engineering, and a few small apps and libraries hosted under their own paths.

## Apps with agent instructions

- [Mise](https://www.jacoelho.com/mise/llms.txt): turns a recipe into a page to cook from. Its instructions say how to open a recipe in it by building a link.

## Pages

- [Articles](https://www.jacoelho.com/blog/): the posts, newest first.
- [Projects](https://www.jacoelho.com/projects/): the other apps and libraries.
- [RSS feed](https://www.jacoelho.com/index.xml)
